Meet the Team

Meet the dedicated professionals behind Oasis HR Hub. Our team brings together experience across key areas of human resources to provide practical guidance, workplace support and people-focused solutions for businesses and employees.

Daniel Brooks

HR Manager

Daniel leads the Oasis HR Hub team, overseeing HR strategy, workplace policies and employee support to help organisations build positive and effective working environments.

Grace Thompson

HR Support Advisor

Grace provides day-to-day HR guidance and practical support, helping employees and managers access the information they need to handle workplace matters confidently.

Amelia Carter

Recruitment Advisor

Amelia supports organisations throughout recruitment and onboarding, helping businesses attract suitable candidates and create a welcoming experience for new employees.

Sophia Williams

Training & Development Advisor

Sophia supports employee learning and professional development, helping organisations create opportunities for their people to build skills and grow in the workplace.

Emily Harrison

HR Compliance Advisor

Emily supports organisations with HR policies, workplace procedures and compliance requirements, helping businesses maintain fair, consistent and effective employment practices.
